story: Founded in Bucharest in 2005 as DeskOver by Daniel Dines and Marius Tîrcă, as a software outsourcing shop building automation libraries and SDKs that IBM, Google and Microsoft embedded in their products. From 2012 the team built a platform for training and orchestrating software robots after the Indian arm of a large BPO chose it in a pilot against other RPA vendors. It was renamed UiPath in 2015, took its first outside money that year and moved its headquarters to New York in 2017.
